title: Voyager 1 Is Now One Full Light-Day Away
hook: Send a message to Voyager 1 right now, and it won't arrive until tomorrow.

scenes.narration: Send a message to Voyager 1 right now, and it won't arrive until tomorrow.
scenes.image_prompt: The Voyager 1 spacecraft with its large white dish antenna drifting alone in pitch-black deep space, a faint distant Sun as a tiny bright star behind it, cinematic lighting, ultra-detailed, vertical composition

scenes.narration: On November 18, 2026, it became the first spacecraft ever to reach one light-day from Earth.
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing line of light stretching from a small blue Earth to a tiny spacecraft at the far edge of the frame, vast starfield, sense of enormous distance, cinematic, vertical

scenes.narration: That's how far light travels in 24 hours. About 16.1 billion miles.
scenes.image_prompt: Streaks of light racing through a dense starfield, motion blur conveying the speed of light, deep violet and blue tones, cinematic, vertical

scenes.narration: It launched in 1977. Roughly 49 years later, it's still out there.
scenes.image_prompt: A vintage 1970s rocket launch at dawn with a thick plume of exhaust, film grain, warm amber tones, blending into a starry sky above, vertical composition

scenes.narration: Past Jupiter. Past Saturn. Into interstellar space in 2012.
scenes.image_prompt: A small spacecraft passing a giant banded Jupiter, then ringed Saturn in the distance, then fading into the dark boundary of interstellar space, epic scale, cinematic, vertical

scenes.narration: But here's the twist: every reply it sends takes another full day to come back.
scenes.image_prompt: A giant radio telescope dish on Earth pointed at a starry night sky, a faint signal wave traveling back from deep space, moody teal lighting, cinematic, vertical

scenes.narration: Its power fades every year, so instruments have been switched off to save it.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of an aging space probe with indicator lights dimming one by one in the dark, faint orange glow, lonely atmosphere, cinematic, vertical

scenes.narration: So ask it a question today, and you'll hear back the day after tomorrow.
scenes.image_prompt: A tiny pale blue dot of Earth suspended in a vast dark void, a thin beam of light reaching out toward deep space, contemplative mood, cinematic, vertical

claims.claim: Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth on November 18, 2026, about 10:16 UTC.
Voyager 1 is the first spacecraft ever to reach one light-day from Earth.
A light-day is the distance light travels in 24 hours, about 16.1 billion miles (25.9 billion km).
A command from Earth takes about 24 hours to reach Voyager 1, and the reply takes another 24 hours to return.
Voyager 1 reached one light-day after roughly 49 years in space.
Voyager 1 flew past Jupiter (1979) and Saturn (1980).
In August 2012 Voyager 1 became the first human-made object to enter interstellar space.
Voyager 1's power output declines every year, so instruments have been switched off over time to save power.

metadata.title: Voyager 1 Is Now So Far Away, a Message Takes a Full Day 🚀
metadata.description: On November 18, 2026, NASA's Voyager 1 became the first spacecraft ever to reach one light-day from Earth, about 16.1 billion miles away. Launched in 1977, it now needs about 24 hours to receive a command and another 24 to answer. Sources: nasa.gov, npr.org, earthsky.org, science.nasa.gov
